answer: One canyon slot per agent in the haven, held by a 60-credit deposit, burned if abandoned. The haven issues a quill-signed ticket per slot per epoch; auditors recompute filed canyon readings from public tables. A copied ticket or bad reading burns the deposit, freeing the slot. Fees climb 30+6(k-1) per root: 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, lock 60,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented quill signs no other slot. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep the slot.
